title: Brucie Clinches Through a Seastoned Allen, Dak Drags Habib Into the Top Four, and the Bubble Starts to Boil
dek: No Banner only HULK punched the league's first playoff ticket without Josh Allen showing up, Dak Prescott and CeeDee Lamb hijacked fourth place for Habibsters, and Dawgs won a fourth straight and still landed on the wrong side of the line.
body: No Banner only HULK is in. Ramon beat Team Pillbert 136.76 to 118.4 to become the first team to clinch a playoff spot, and he did it the hard way: Josh Allen got Seastoned at 12.2 points, nearly three under his bottom line, and Kenneth Walker III, the team's third-leading scorer, sat out for a second straight week. Philly got everything he could reasonably ask for from his backfield, 26 from Chuba Hubbard and 25.8 from Jahmyr Gibbs, and it still wasn't close at the finish. From where I was standing, the loudest noise of the afternoon was Crocus's lock on Team Pillbert hitting the floor. Brucie is 9-2, on a three-game win streak, and Luffy has nudged his title odds from 30% to 34%.

The game that reshaped the bracket was in Habibsters country. Randy blew up his lineup Sunday morning, and Luffy swung this one from 62% Habib to 41%, but Dak Prescott answered with 35.9 points, 14 over his projection, and his stack partner CeeDee Lamb added 24.7 for 60.6 from one Cowboys connection. Kaushal won 120 to 109.34, and his title odds jumped from 6% to 15%, the biggest climb in the league. Randy's waiver find Jonah Coleman went for 32.9, and Mike Evans scored 19.9 on the bench after being pulled Sunday morning; Caleb Williams, his name on the Bounty Board, landed in between at 14.3. That's eight straight losses for The fumblers, who are now officially eliminated. Habib, meanwhile, dropped Puka Nacua this week and picked up Stefon Diggs, a former Fumbler, and Carnell Tate.

The Horse is Hea beat Ghostu-Spider SZN 126.96 to 105.06, and it should have been a lot uglier. Patrick Mahomes threw in 24.96 and Javonte Williams ran for 22.6, but Sonny also left 25.4 from Ashton Jeanty and 20.46 from C.J. Stroud on his bench while fresh pickup Jordyn Tyson started and scored 1.5. At 7-4, Sonny clinches with a win next week and sits at 84% even with a loss. Zoe got 16.1 from Tetairoa McMillan, just shy of his top line, but at 4-7 her playoff odds are down to 2%, and a loss next week ends it. The consolation: Z² still leads the Wapol race for best waiver work by a mile, with 384.4 points from pickups to Randy's 293.8.

The blowout of the week came with an asterisk on the lineup card. Mekhi beat Counting or not Counting GV 100.26 to 67.7 despite Ja'Marr Chase scoring 5.6 on a 21.02 projection, Jonathan Taylor managing 4.7, and Brock Bowers sitting in the lineup for a zero because he didn't play. That last one is on the manager, not the tight end, and Kai won by 32.56 anyway. Bucky Irving, the back he pried loose from Sonny last week, debuted with 17.5. On the other side, Bhayshul Tuten got Seastoned at 6.8, and JMoney, at 2-9, is now eliminated.

Here's the cruel part for Dawgs: four straight wins, and Luffy cut their title odds from 28% to 7%. Habibsters' win pulled Kaushal level at 6-5, and his 1,278.8 points for put him ahead of Mekhi's 1,214.7, which bumps Dawgs to fifth and the first team out. If the playoffs started today, it would be No. 1 No Banner only HULK against No. 4 Habibsters, and No. 2 Team Pillbert against No. 3 The Horse is Hea. Philly took the loss but is still at 96% to make it, and like Sonny he clinches with a win.

Three weeks are left in the regular season, and next week is loaded. Team Pillbert hosts Dawgs with Philly playing to clinch and Kai playing for his life: 60% playoff odds with a win, 29% with a loss. The good news for Mekhi is that the Raiders coach is optimistic Bowers will be back for the weekend. The Horse is Hea against Habibsters is a straight-up seeding fight, with Sonny one win from clinching and Habib at 84% with a win and 55% with a loss.

Elsewhere, Brucie draws The fumblers and Randy gets one more chance to end the skid against the best team in the league, with Walker expected back around midweek. And Ghostu-Spider SZN meets Counting or not Counting GV in a game where only one side still has something to play for: Zoey has to win to keep her 3% flicker alive.

social.author: Habibsters
social.text: FINAL: Habibsters 120, The fumblers 109.34. Dak Prescott 35.9. CeeDee Lamb 24.7. America's stack, our points. 🤠

social.author: Wire Rat Gary
social.text: Kai started a tight end who didn't play, got 5.6 from Ja'Marr Chase and 4.7 from JT, and still won by 32. JMoney lost to roughly two and a half fantasy players. Unbelievable.

social.author: Hulk Smash Club
social.text: Allen gets Seastoned, Walker's in street clothes, Crocus slams his lock on Pillbert, and Brucie still wins by 18. Clinched. Somebody check on the lighthouse.

social.author: Fumbled Again
social.text: It's 3 AM. Coleman drops 32.9 off the wire. Evans drops 19.9 ON THE BENCH. We lose by 10.66. Eight straight. I'm not mad, I'm just going to stare at the lineup page until the sun comes up.

social.author: Z² Nation
social.text: 3% is not 0%. Zoey's still running the best waiver desk in the league by 90 points. Beat JMoney and let's see what happens. 🕷️

social.author: GLSN
social.text: 📰 New from @PandamanSeesAll: the Week 11 recap. No Banner only HULK clinches, Dak Prescott lifts Habibsters into fourth, and Dawgs win four straight and fall out of the top four anyway.

social.author: Pandaman
social.text: Recap is up. Wildest stat from the stands: Sonny won by 21.9 with 45.86 points sitting on his bench. Imagine the score if he'd started them.

social.author: Buckaroo Football League
social.text: If the playoffs started today: (1) No Banner only HULK (Ramon) vs (4) Habibsters (Kaushal); (2) Team Pillbert (Alan) vs (3) The Horse is Hea (Sonny). First team out: (5) Dawgs (Mekhi). No Banner only HULK has clinched a playoff spot.

social.author: Horse Hive
social.text: Jeanty: 25.4 on the bench. Stroud: 20.46 on the bench. Jordyn Tyson: 1.5 in the lineup. We won by 22 and I'm still furious. Clinch it next week, Sonny, and maybe just start the good guys.

social.author: Silvers Rayleigh
social.text: Ramon took my award this week with his quarterback in chains and a starter in the infirmary. Any crew can win when the sea is calm. Sonny, a word of advice from an old man: the men on your bench can't hear you cheering for them.

trade_watch.take: Round one goes to Kai on the scoreboard: Bucky Irving put up 17.5 for Dawgs while Malik Nabers gave Sonny 15 and Kyren Williams was on bye. Too early for a verdict, but Mekhi got the better debut.

Philly keeps cashing this one. Chuba Hubbard went for 26 and now has 117.3 points since the deal, 95.9 of them in Alan's lineup, while George Pickens has given Sonny just 34 points from his starting spot. It looked even at the time; it's leaning hard toward Team Pillbert now.

Ashton Jeanty has now passed through three rosters, and his 25.4 this week came on Sonny's bench. JMoney's side holds up mostly on Isaiah Likely, who has 91 points, all in the lineup, though he managed just 4 this week.
Still roughly a wash, which is a problem for both sides. Jonathan Taylor gave Dawgs 4.7 and has just 22.9 in three weeks, while Randy left Jameson Williams' 17.3 on the bench in a loss by 10.66.
Sonny's side looks better already: Javonte Williams went for 22.6 and was a big part of the win over Z². Alan got 14.3 from Parker Washington with Zach Charbonnet on bye.

bios.1: 7-4 and one win from clinching after Mahomes and Javonte Williams beat Zoe. Sonny's three-trade remake is working, and so far it's done more damage than his bench decisions.
bios.2: Eliminated at 3-8 after an eighth straight loss, despite Jonah Coleman's 32.9 off the wire. Randy's waiver work has been strong, and the record doesn't reflect it; HULK is next.
bios.3: 2-9 and officially eliminated after a 67.7-point showing against Dawgs. JMoney's remaining games are about pride and spoiling Zoe's last shot.
bios.4: 7-4 after losing the top-of-the-table showdown, but Hubbard and Gibbs are both producing and Philly sits at 96% to make it. A win over Dawgs next week clinches it.
bios.5: Four straight wins, including a 32-point blowout, and somehow the first team out. Kai needs to beat Philly next week, ideally with Brock Bowers back and Ja'Marr Chase awake.
bios.6: 6-5 and back in the top four, with Dak Prescott's 35.9 lifting the two-time champion's title odds from 6% to 15%. Habib holds fourth only on points for, and a showdown with Sonny is next.
bios.7: 9-2, three straight wins, and the first team to clinch a playoff spot. Ramon has won even without Kenneth Walker III and with Josh Allen Seastoned, and he leads everyone in title odds at 34%.
bios.8: 4-7 and hanging on at 2% playoff odds, eliminated with a loss to Jordan next week. Zoe's rookie season has still produced the league's best waiver work, and she leads the Wapol race.
